claim_boundary: This audit distinguishes 2022 local-relay hypotheses, an independent FC2 goal-interface positive control, and newer persistent-goal candidates. Structural support does not establish functional transmission. Absence of a direct edge must not be treated as absence of a multi-cell mechanism. Thresholds are fixed before observing this MaleCNS audit.
